scope: Metadata-only explicit target preparation and fail-closed negative cases; synthetic SQLite and paths, no daily migration or credential content.

checks.name: valid metadata preparation passes while RC10 and independent operation gates block release
missing target fields and self-supplied ready flags are rejected
missing paths fail preparation instead of being silently created
leaf and ancestor symlinks are rejected
private directory permissions are checked without reading its files
migration gaps and altered checksums are rejected without repair
older and future schema are explicit blockers
schema metadata does not hide a missing required table
remote host and failed exact process probe are unverifiable and block preparation
exact live local process identity is active, never a stopped-host proof
unknown model calls remain present and block a clean-preparation claim
master-key existence never proves matching and key contents are not parsed
registered project omissions and native workspace mismatch are explicit
RC10 evidence digest mismatch is rejected
forged green RC10 booleans and backup manifest cannot authorize deployment
private key path cannot be presented as a public release file
WAL sources are refused before SQLite opens and DB/WAL/SHM bytes stay unchanged
